# Punikonta VHS shader

- Source: https://github.com/punikonta/godot-shader-crt-vhs
- Revision: `6ba87f95c152ec023fc07c4f77e87bdd70783afa`
- Upstream file: `shaders/vhs.gdshader`
- License: MIT
- Copyright: Marcel Jovic <punikonta@protonmail.com>

The engine's Vulkan GLSL implementation preserves the upstream effect model
while adapting its Godot uniforms, screen sampling, coordinate orientation, and
texture-fetch pattern to the GameEngine post-processing pipeline.
